item.title: 曝苹果削减 iPhone 18 Pro 订单，供应链称总量变化不大
item.guid: 曝苹果削减-iPhone-18-Pro-订单，供应链称总量变化不大
item.description:
According to a Nikkei Asia report on October 9, Apple has asked some suppliers to reduce component orders for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. 据《日经亚洲》10 月 9 日报道，苹果已要求部分供应商下调 iPhone 18 Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max 的零部件订单。

Sources cited in the report stated that Apple's October component orders for these two models were reduced by at least 15% compared to initial requests, with one supply chain insider claiming a reduction of approximately 15% to 20%. The report suggests that rising storage chip costs have driven up the price of new phones, potentially curbing consumer demand. 报道援引知情人士称，苹果 10 月对这两款机型的零部件订单较最初要求减少至少 15%，其中一名供应链人士称降幅约为 15% 至 20%。报道认为，存储芯片成本上涨推高了新机售价，可能抑制消费者需求。

However, statements from the supply chain regarding order changes are inconsistent. Jiemian News reported on October 9, citing sources from Apple's supply chain companies, that Apple recently adjusted its shipping guidance, with iPhone 18 Pro orders decreasing but iPhone 18 Pro Max orders increasing, resulting in little change to the overall order volume. 不过，供应链方面对订单变化的说法并不一致。界面新闻 10 月 9 日援引苹果供应链公司人士称，苹果近期调整了出货指引，iPhone 18 Pro 订单有所减少，但 iPhone 18 Pro Max 订单增加，目前整体订单量变化不大。

Another supply chain source stated that Apple is reallocating some iPhone 18 Pro orders to the higher-demand Pro Max model, with no reduction in the total volume. 另一名供应链人士则称，苹果是在将部分 iPhone 18 Pro 订单调整至需求较强的 Pro Max 机型，总量没有减少。

item.title: 苹果调整并购团队架构，7 年来首次重新归入财务部门
item.guid: 苹果调整并购团队架构，7-年来首次重新归入财务部门
item.description:
According to Bloomberg, Apple's new CEO John Ternus is once again driving personnel changes: Steve Smith will replace Adrian Perica as head of M&A, reporting to CFO Kevan Parekh; Apple's M&A team will also be reintegrated into the finance department after 7 years. 据彭博社报道，苹果新任 CEO John Ternus 再次推动公司人事调整：Steve Smith 将接替 Adrian Perica 出任并购主管，并向 CFO Kevan Parekh 汇报；苹果并购团队也将时隔 7 年重新纳入财务部门。

After stepping down as head of M&A, Perica will continue to be responsible for iCloud, Fitness+, and News services, reporting to Eddy Cue, head of services. Cue's management scope will expand to include the App Store, health, and fitness teams, while Carson Oliver has been promoted to Vice President of the App Store, responsible for daily platform management. The report, citing internal sources, states that Apple has not yet officially announced these changes externally. Perica 卸任并购主管后，将继续负责 iCloud、Fitness+ 和 News 业务，并向服务业务主管 Eddy Cue 汇报。Cue 的管理范围将扩大至 App Store、健康和健身团队，Carson Oliver 则升任 App Store 副总裁，负责平台日常管理。报道援引内部知情人士称，苹果尚未对外正式宣布这些调整。

item.title: 豆包据称在建设水电燃气缴费等生活服务能力
item.guid: 豆包据称在建设水电燃气缴费等生活服务能力
item.description:
The Paper reported on October 9 that users have provided feedback that they can initiate commands for utility payments such as water, electricity, and gas within the Doubao App via voice or text. Sources close to Doubao told The Paper that Doubao is gradually building its service capabilities for daily life scenarios, including travel services and utility payments. 澎湃新闻 10 月 9 日报道，有用户反馈称，在豆包 App 内通过语音或文字可以发起水、电、燃气等生活缴费指令。接近豆包人士向澎湃新闻表示，豆包正在逐步建设出行服务、生活缴费等生活场景下的办事能力。

Doubao previously launched features such as flight booking, train ticket purchasing, ride-hailing, and route navigation, allowing users to describe their needs directly using natural language, with Doubao recognizing the intent and calling partner services. The report states that Doubao's life service layout is continuously expanding, with current public information mainly coming from user feedback and statements from close sources. 豆包此前已上线机票预订、火车票购买、打车出行和路线导航等功能，用户可以直接用自然语言描述需求，由豆包识别意图并调用合作服务。报道称，豆包的生活服务布局还在持续扩展，当前公开信息主要来自用户反馈和接近人士说法。

item.title: 小米 17 Ultra 官网全系涨价 1000 元，华为 nova 16 系列也调价
item.guid: 小米-17-Ultra-官网全系涨价-1000-元，华为-nova-16-系列也调价
item.description:
On October 9, Jiemian News checked Xiaomi's official website and found that the price of the Xiaomi 17 Ultra Standard Edition 12GB+512GB has increased from its initial launch price of 6999 yuan to 7999 yuan, with all capacity versions of both the Standard and Leica editions rising by 1000 yuan. Xiaomi customer service confirmed to Jiemian News that the price adjustment is mainly due to rising procurement costs of core components, but their backend cannot query the specific adjustment date. 10 月 9 日，界面新闻查询小米官网发现，小米 17 Ultra 标准版 12GB+512GB 售价已由首发时的 6999 元升至 7999 元，标准版及徕卡版各容量版本均上涨 1000 元。小米客服向界面新闻确认，调价主要受核心元器件采购成本上涨影响，但其后台无法查询具体调价日期。

Cailian Press and STAR Market Daily disclosed on the same day that the suggested retail prices for Huawei nova 16 and nova 16 Pro have increased by 400 yuan, and nova 16 SE by 200 yuan. 财联社、科创板日报同日披露，华为 nova 16 和 nova 16 Pro 建议零售价上调 400 元，nova 16 SE 上调 200 元。

item.title: OpenAI 等公司推演重大 AI 事故后的公众与政策应对
item.guid: OpenAI-等公司推演重大-AI-事故后的公众与政策应对
item.description:
According to an Axios report on October 9, executives from AI companies like Anthropic and OpenAI are privately simulating how their companies would face public backlash and potential regulatory actions if AI were to cause a major real-world accident. 据 Axios 10 月 9 日报道，Anthropic、OpenAI 等 AI 公司的高管正在私下推演：如果 AI 引发重大现实事故，公司如何面对公众反弹，以及随后可能出现的监管行动。

Interviewees primarily envisioned large-scale cyberattacks that could disrupt financial services, internet connectivity, and even power and water supplies. Scenarios included both AI agents losing control during testing and malicious users exploiting open models. The drills involved worst-case red team testing and explaining technology and risks to U.S. members of Congress, attempting to influence policies that might be adopted after a crisis. 受访人士重点设想的是大规模网络攻击，可能令金融服务、互联网连接，甚至供电和供水中断。情景既包括测试中的智能体失控，也包括恶意使用者利用已开放模型。演练涉及最坏情形的红队测试，以及向美国国会议员解释技术与风险，试图影响危机后可能采用的政策。

An OpenAI spokesperson confirmed that the company conducts emergency preparedness drills, allowing teams to discuss and simulate various potential scenarios, while emphasizing that the company does not treat these scenarios as inevitable but aims to be prepared for different situations. Anthropic declined to comment. OpenAI 发言人确认，公司会开展应急准备演练，让团队讨论并推演多种潜在情景，同时强调，公司不会把这些情景当作必然发生的事，目的是为不同情况做好准备。Anthropic 拒绝置评。

Axios stated that some industry insiders are concerned about a major incident occurring within the next 6 to 12 months. This reflects the interviewees' assessment of risk, and OpenAI's response did not treat an accident as inevitable. Axios 称，一些业内人士担心未来 6 至 12 个月内出现重大事件。这是受访者对风险的判断，OpenAI 的回应并未将事故视为必然。

item.title: 保时捷计划提高顶级车型平均售价约 20%，压缩衍生版本
item.guid: 保时捷计划提高顶级车型平均售价约-20%，压缩衍生版本
item.description:
Porsche unveiled a new strategy at its Capital Markets Day on October 7, planning to increase the average selling price of its top-tier models by approximately 20% in the medium term. This goal stems from a higher-value product portfolio and positioning adjustments, not an immediate price hike for all existing models. 保时捷在 10 月 7 日资本市场日公布新战略，计划在中期将顶级车型平均售价提高约 20%。这一目标来自更高价值的产品组合与定位调整，并非宣布现有全系车型立即涨价。

Product planning will reduce derivative versions by approximately 20%, while aiming to increase sales of each version by about 30%. The company also plans to launch a new mid-engine sports car positioned above the 911 and introduce at least one brand-defining product annually before 2030. 产品规划将减少约 20% 的衍生版本，同时争取把每个版本的销量提高约 30%。公司还计划推出定位高于 911 的新中置发动机跑车，并在 2030 年前每年至少带来一款能够定义品牌的产品。

Porsche refers to this direction as "Sportwagenschmiede 3.5," aiming to reduce complexity and concentrate resources on models with greater brand recognition and profitability. 保时捷将这套方向称为「Sportwagenschmiede 3.5」，希望降低复杂度，把资源集中到更具品牌辨识度和盈利能力的车型上。

item.title: IDC：第三季度全球 PC 出货量下降 20.1%，旺季未现
item.guid: IDC：第三季度全球-PC-出货量下降-20.1%，旺季未现
item.description:
Preliminary data released by IDC on October 9 shows that global traditional PC shipments in the third quarter of 2026 totaled 62.7 million units, a year-on-year decrease of 20.1% and a quarter-on-quarter decrease of 9.1%. The market has contracted for two consecutive quarters, with the decline widening from 3.8% in the second quarter. IDC 10 月 9 日发布的初步数据显示，2026 年第三季度全球传统 PC 出货量为 6270 万台，同比下降 20.1%，环比下降 9.1%。市场连续两个季度收缩，降幅较第二季度的 3.8% 扩大。

IDC attributed the decline to ongoing supply constraints, as well as manufacturers and channel partners stocking up early at the beginning of the year before price increases, overdrawing subsequent demand. In the third quarter, channels mainly digested previous inventory, and the seasonal rebound of 'Q3 higher than Q2' seen in previous years did not occur. Lenovo, HP, and Dell all saw larger declines than the overall market, with their combined share decreasing by 4.2 percentage points. IDC 将下滑归因于持续的供应限制，以及厂商、渠道商年初赶在涨价前提前备货，透支了后续需求。三季度渠道主要消化此前库存，往年「三季度高于二季度」的季节性回升没有出现。联想、HP 和 Dell 的降幅均高于整体市场，合计份额减少 4.2 个百分点。

Jitesh Ubrani, research director for IDC's consumer devices, believes that high inventory and high prices are suppressing demand. Channels may offer short-term promotions, but prices are unlikely to return to last year's levels. This statistic covers desktops, notebooks, and workstations, excluding tablets and x86 servers; shipments also do not equate to end-user retail sales. IDC 消费设备研究总监 Jitesh Ubrani 认为，高库存与高价格正在抑制需求，渠道可能短期促销，但价格难回一年前水平。本次统计覆盖台式机、笔记本和工作站，不含平板与 x86 服务器；出货量也不等同于终端零售销量。

item.title: 英国皇家邮政承认广告使用 AI 配音，已故演员家属质疑声音被复刻
item.guid: 英国皇家邮政承认广告使用-AI-配音，已故演员家属质疑声音被复刻
item.description:
A Deadline investigation on October 9 revealed that Royal Mail admitted to using AI voiceover for its 2025 Christmas advertisement. The daughter of the late BBC announcer Paul Vaughan, who also voiced Paddington Bear, believes the ad's voice is highly similar to her father's and questioned the replication of his voice without family permission. Deadline 10 月 9 日调查披露，英国皇家邮政承认其 2025 年圣诞广告使用 AI 配音。已故 BBC 播音员、曾为《帕丁顿熊》配音的 Paul Vaughan 的女儿认为，广告声音与父亲高度相似，并质疑未经家属许可复刻声音。

Producer Fameplay stated that the voiceover was generated by ElevenLabs but denied intentionally cloning Vaughan. Sound experts told Deadline that there were indeed similarities, but auditory perception alone could not prove direct cloning; ElevenLabs did not answer questions about the source of its training material. 制作方 Fameplay 称，配音通过 ElevenLabs 生成，但否认有意克隆 Vaughan。声音专家向 Deadline 表示，两者确有相似之处，仅凭听感无法证明直接克隆；ElevenLabs 则未回答训练材料来源问题。

Following the controversy, ElevenLabs has added Vaughan to its list of voices prohibited from direct cloning. While the use of AI voiceover in the advertisement has been confirmed, whether the actor's voice material was used remains the core of the dispute. 争议发生后，ElevenLabs 已将 Vaughan 纳入禁止直接克隆的名单。广告使用 AI 配音已经得到确认，是否使用了这位演员的声音材料，仍是双方争议所在。

item.title: 曾被字节辞退的田柯宇获近 3000 万美元融资，研发世界模型
item.guid: 曾被字节辞退的田柯宇获近-3000-万美元融资，研发世界模型
item.description:
According to Bloomberg, Tian Keyu, who was previously dismissed by ByteDance for violations, has raised nearly $30 million for a lab developing a world model, with a post-money valuation of approximately $200 million. Investors include 5Y Capital and IDG, both of which confirmed their investments to Bloomberg. 据彭博社报道，曾因违规被字节跳动辞退的田柯宇，已为一家研发世界模型的实验室筹集近 3000 万美元，投后估值约 2 亿美元。投资方包括五源资本和 IDG，两家机构均向彭博确认了投资。

The team of about 10 people currently has no official name or product. Tian Keyu said the team has built a 'visual dictionary' containing 200,000 symbols, hoping to use AI's own symbols to process videos, then input about 100 million hours of video to learn the real world, with plans to release a complete model in 2027. 这个约 10 人的团队尚无正式名称或产品。田柯宇说，团队已构建包含 20 万个符号的「视觉字典」，希望用 AI 自己的符号处理视频，再输入约 1 亿小时的视频学习现实世界，计划于 2027 年发布完整模型。

Tian Keyu is the first author of the visual autoregressive model (VAR) paper, one of the best papers at NeurIPS 2024. A ruling reviewed by Bloomberg showed that he was ordered to pay 500,000 yuan for violating his contract with ByteDance. In an interview, he admitted to having shut down another intern's program to free up computing power and stated that if he had to do it again, he would take a smarter approach. 田柯宇是 NeurIPS 2024 最佳论文之一、视觉自回归模型 VAR 论文的第一作者。彭博查阅的裁决显示，他因违反与字节的合同被判赔 50 万元。他在采访中承认，曾关闭另一名实习生的程序以释放算力，并表示如果重来，会采取更明智的做法。

The company currently prioritizes technology development, and Tian Keyu stated that he has not yet focused on consumer products or business models. 这家公司目前优先研发技术，田柯宇称尚未把精力放在消费产品或商业模式上。

item.title: Jev 开发商 TypeSafe AI 融资约 8.7 亿美元，估值达 75 亿美元
item.guid: Jev-开发商-TypeSafe-AI-融资约-8.7-亿美元，估值达-75-亿美元
item.description:
According to a Bloomberg report on October 9, TypeSafe AI, the developer of the AI model Jev, has completed approximately $870 million (about 5.8 billion RMB) in funding, reaching a valuation of $7.5 billion (about 50 billion RMB), led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). 据彭博社 10 月 9 日报道，AI 模型 Jev 的开发商 TypeSafe AI 完成约 8.7 亿美元（约合人民币 58 亿元）融资，估值达到 75 亿美元（约 500 亿元人民币），由 Andreessen Horowitz（a16z）领投。

This funding was completed weeks after Jev's release. Co-founder Diogo Almeida stated that after the product launch video went viral, interest in the company from corporate executives, developers, and investors rapidly increased. 这笔融资在 Jev 发布数周后完成。联合创始人 Diogo Almeida 表示，产品发布视频走红后，企业高管、开发者和投资者对公司的兴趣迅速增加。

TypeSafe stated that Jev's user count surpassed 1 million within days, and approximately one-third of Fortune 500 companies have used the model; the company did not disclose the names of these enterprises. TypeSafe 称，Jev 的用户数在数天内突破 100 万，约三分之一的《财富》500 强企业已使用该模型；公司未公开这些企业的名称。

item.title: 尼康取消显微视频赛事原冠军资格，称作品违反生成式 AI 规则
item.guid: 尼康取消显微视频赛事原冠军资格，称作品违反生成式-AI-规则
item.description:
Nikon has disqualified the original first-place winner of this year's Small World in Motion microscopic video competition. Nikon stated that the video did not comply with the competition's rules regarding generative AI, and the updated champion is now Nguyen Nam Nhat's work. 尼康取消了今年 Small World in Motion 显微视频大赛原第一名作品的获奖资格。尼康表示，该视频不符合赛事关于生成式 AI 的规则，更新后的冠军已改为 Nguyen Nam Nhat 的作品。

According to The Verge's report on October 9, the video by original winner Dr. Ning Xu claimed to show the movement of tiny cilia in the respiratory tract of a child with primary ciliary dyskinesia (PCD). After the video's authenticity was questioned online, Nikon began a review last week. 据 The Verge 10 月 9 日报道，原获奖者 Ning Xu 博士的视频声称展示了一名原发性纤毛运动障碍（PCD）患儿呼吸道中，微小纤毛的运动。视频真实性在网上受到质疑后，尼康于上周开始复核。

In a LinkedIn comment, Xu admitted to using AI, but described it as post-processing: utilizing unsupervised neural networks for feature differentiation and visualization of grayscale images reconstructed from super-resolution optical imaging. Nikon ultimately determined that the work violated competition rules, and the video has now been removed from the event website. Xu 在 LinkedIn 评论中承认使用了 AI，但将其描述为后期处理：利用无监督神经网络，对超分辨率光学成像重建的灰度图像进行特征区分和可视化。尼康最终认定作品违反比赛规则，视频现已从赛事网站移除。

Nikon stated that it would re-examine the rules and judging procedures for future competitions, while emphasizing that the disqualification should not be interpreted as a judgment on the participant's professional reputation, scientific contributions, or intentions. 尼康表示，将重新审视未来比赛的规则和评审程序，同时强调，取消资格不应被解读为对参赛者专业声誉、科研贡献或意图的判断。

item.title: 💡 AHM 呼吁数学研究回到以人类理解为中心
item.guid: 💡-AHM-呼吁数学研究回到以人类理解为中心
item.description:
The Communications Working Group of the Association for Human Mathematics (AHM) issued a statement on October 7, criticizing OpenAI's concentrated public release of mathematical manuscripts the day before, and calling on mathematicians to cease cooperation with OpenAI. Terence Tao subsequently reposted this guest statement on his personal blog. This open letter focuses the controversy on the norms and understanding of mathematical research, and questions how answers provided by models can become academic achievements. 人类数学协会（AHM）传播工作组 10 月 7 日发表声明，批评 OpenAI 前一天集中公开数学手稿的做法，并呼吁数学家停止与 OpenAI 合作。陶哲轩随后在个人博客转载了这份客座声明。这份公开信将争议落在数学研究的规范与理解上，并对模型给出的答案如何成为学术成果提出质疑。

AHM wrote that mathematicians have a perception of progress shaped by history and disciplinary characteristics. Credibility, adherence to research ethics, and serving the public interest are conditions for evaluating mathematical research. The association therefore rejected OpenAI's claim that this release promoted mathematical progress, and advised mathematicians and the public to view this publication model with caution. AHM 写道，数学家对进步有一套受历史与学科特点塑造的认识。可信、符合研究伦理且服务公共利益，是评价数学研究的条件。协会因此拒绝 OpenAI 关于这次发布推动数学进步的主张，并建议数学家与公众审慎看待这种发表模式。

The statement also cited recommendations from the Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence (AGMAI), stating that leading AI companies should not arbitrarily test advanced mathematical problems with internal models; AHM believes that OpenAI ignored this premise, yet used the advisory group to provide legitimacy for itself, undermining the norms of the academic community. 声明还援引数学与人工智能咨询小组（AGMAI）的建议，称前沿 AI 公司不应擅自用内部模型测试高级数学问题；AHM 认为，OpenAI 忽视这一前提，却借用该咨询小组为自身提供正当性，损害了学术共同体的规范。

Regarding the public release of over 700 documents at once, AHM's judgment is: this is more like a show of force and cannot be considered an academic contribution based solely on its scale. The direction it proposes is to return to human-understanding-centered scientific practice. This is AHM's organizational stance; Terence Tao indicated the author's identity in the reposting note and did not present it as a statement signed by himself. 对一次公开超过 700 份文件，AHM 的判断是：这更像力量展示，不能仅凭规模视为学术贡献。它提出的方向是回到以人类理解为中心的科学实践。这是 AHM 的组织立场；陶哲轩在转载说明中标明作者身份，并未将其作为自己署名的声明。

🔗 Related Reading: Terence Tao forwards boycott statement, mathematics community and OpenAI completely fall out 🔗 相关阅读： 陶哲轩转发抵制声明，数学界和OpenAI彻底撕破脸

item.title: 比亚迪公开人形机器人外观专利，面向服务、教育和工业场景
item.guid: 比亚迪公开人形机器人外观专利，面向服务、教育和工业场景
item.description:
On October 9, the National Intellectual Property Administration announced an appearance design patent for an embodied intelligent robot, with BYD Co., Ltd. as the patentee. The patent description shows that this humanoid robot has walking, balancing, and interactive functions, and can be used in service robots, education, or industrial scenarios. 国家知识产权局 10 月 9 日公示了一项具身智能机器人外观设计专利，专利权人为比亚迪股份有限公司。专利说明显示，这款人形机器人具备行走、平衡和交互功能，可用于服务机器人、教育或工业场景。

BYD Executive Vice President Li Ke stated in June this year that he hopes every BYD store will deploy 2 to 3 robots in the future for explaining and demonstrating vehicles. This public disclosure is an appearance design patent, and the specific product release time or mass production arrangements have not yet been revealed. 比亚迪执行副总裁李柯今年 6 月曾表示，希望未来每家比亚迪门店都部署 2 至 3 台机器人，用于讲解和演示车辆。此次公开的是外观设计专利，尚未披露具体产品发布时间或量产安排。

item.title: TRAE 合并 TraeWork 与 TraeCode，支持 Agent 和 IDE 双模式
item.guid: TRAE-合并-TraeWork-与-TraeCode，支持-Agent-和-IDE-双模式
item.description:
TRAE.ai announced the merger of TraeWork and TraeCode into the new TRAE, with phased gray-scale rollout beginning. The new version offers Agent mode and IDE mode, covering desktop, web, and mobile platforms; the former focuses on task collaboration, while the latter retains the in-editor development experience. TRAE.ai 宣布将 TraeWork 与 TraeCode 合并为全新 TRAE，并开始分批灰度推送。新版提供 Agent 模式和 IDE 模式，覆盖桌面、Web 与移动端；前者围绕任务协作展开，后者保留编辑器内的开发体验。

Developers can manage multiple projects in the same workspace, run multiple Agents in parallel, and connect to local projects or SSH remote environments. Automation, templates, and "My Assistant" are used to handle repetitive tasks and non-coding work such as documentation, reporting, and organization. 开发者可以在同一工作区管理多个项目，并行运行多个 Agent，连接本地项目或 SSH 远程环境。自动化、模板和「我的助理」则用于处理重复任务及文档、汇报、整理等编码之外的工作。

Code changes, HTML, PPT, Word, images, videos, and reports are all consolidated into "My Artifacts". The official announcement also provides different migration paths for two old clients, with chat records, accounts, and local data retained according to the corresponding plans. 代码变更、HTML、PPT、Word、图片、视频和报告统一进入「我的产物」。官方同时给出两款旧客户端的不同迁移路径，聊天记录、账户及本地数据等按对应方案保留。

item.title: JetBrains 发布 Mellum 2.1，重点增强智能体编程能力
item.guid: JetBrains-发布-Mellum-2.1，重点增强智能体编程能力
item.description:
JetBrains released its programming AI model Mellum 2.1, continuing to use a 12B mixed-expert architecture, 2.5B active parameters, and an Apache 2.0 license. This update extends reinforcement learning from short-term fine-tuning to the main training body and incorporates task data from mathematics, algorithmic competitions, tool invocation, and software engineering. JetBrains 发布编程 AI 模型 Mellum 2.1，继续采用 12B 混合专家架构、2.5B 活跃参数和 Apache 2.0 许可证。此次更新把强化学习从短期收尾环节扩展到训练主体，并加入数学、算法竞赛、工具调用和软件工程等任务数据。

Mellum 2.1 can explore codebases, edit files, and check modification results. JetBrains states that it can identify the root cause of failed tests, draft repair solutions, and verify the results. The model is now available on Hugging Face, supporting local or self-owned infrastructure deployment; in single-request scenarios, multi-token prediction can increase speed by approximately 1.6 times, and high-load inference throughput is nearly double that of Qwen3.5-9B. Mellum 2.1 可以探索代码库、编辑文件并检查修改结果，JetBrains 称其能识别失败测试的根因、起草修复方案并验证结果。模型已登陆 Hugging Face，支持本地或自有基础设施部署；单请求场景下，多 Token 预测可让速度提升约 1.6 倍，高负载推理吞吐量接近 Qwen3.5-9B 的两倍。

item.title: 一加与京东方发布第四代东方屏，支持全局 165Hz、游戏 185Hz
item.guid: 一加与京东方发布第四代东方屏，支持全局-165Hz、游戏-185Hz
item.description:
OnePlus and BOE jointly released the fourth-generation Oriental Screen on October 9, which will debut on the OnePlus 16, launching on October 12. The new screen uses custom X4 luminous material and a new LTPO ultra-high refresh rate circuit, supporting a global 165Hz in daily use and up to 185Hz in gaming scenarios. 一加与京东方 10 月 9 日发布第四代东方屏，将由 10 月 12 日发布的一加 16 首发搭载。新屏采用双方定制的 X4 发光材料和全新 LTPO 超高刷电路，日常场景支持全局 165Hz，游戏场景最高支持 185Hz。

OnePlus states that with the new circuit and luminous material, the global 165Hz power consumption is essentially on par with the previous generation's 120Hz screen. The self-developed Super Display Chip P4 optimizes dynamic clarity for fast scrolling and motion in games. 一加称，新电路与发光材料配合后，全局 165Hz 功耗与上代 120Hz 屏幕基本持平。自研超级显示芯片 P4 则针对快速滑动和游戏中的运动画面优化动态清晰度。

The display also features three hardware calibrations, 1nit low-light display, 3840Hz PWM dimming, and 1.15mm symmetrical bezels. The official announcement also confirms that the OnePlus 16 will be equipped with a 9000mAh Glacier Battery; this appearance showcases the screen technology, while the full device launch event will be held on October 12. 显示部分还包括三次硬件校准、1nit 暗光显示、3840Hz PWM 调光，以及 1.15mm 四等边。官方同步确认，一加 16 将配备 9000mAh 冰川电池；本次亮相的是屏幕技术，整机发布会将在 10 月 12 日举行。

item.title: 新款理想 i6 披露六项升级，10 月 28 日正式发布
item.guid: 新款理想-i6-披露六项升级，10-月-28-日正式发布
item.description:
Li Auto disclosed six upgrades for the new i6 on October 9. The new car will make its European debut in Paris on October 12 and will be officially launched on October 28. 理想汽车 10 月 9 日披露新款 i6 的六项升级。新车将于 10 月 12 日在巴黎完成欧洲首秀，并于 10 月 28 日正式发布。

  • Seats and Screens: The front row features full-size zero-gravity seats, supporting a 150° recline, 16-way adjustment, and 18-point massage; the front screen is upgraded to 29-inch 6K, and the rear to 21-inch 4K. 座椅与屏幕：前排采用全尺寸零重力座椅，支持 150° 躺姿、16 向调节和 18 点按摩；前排屏幕升级至 29 英寸 6K，后排为 21 英寸 4K。
  • Body Convenience Features: Added electric front trunk and equipped with ADB matrix headlights. 车身便利功能：新增电动前备箱，搭载 ADB 矩阵大灯。
  • Three-electric System and Computing Platform: Equipped with a self-developed 96kWh 5C battery, CLTC range for RWD and AWD versions are 780 km and 710 km respectively; Qualcomm 8797 cockpit chip and Mach M100 intelligent driving chip become standard. 三电与计算平台：配备自研 96kWh 5C 电池，后驱版、四驱版 CLTC 续航分别为 780 公里、710 公里；高通 8797 座舱芯片与马赫 M100 智驾芯片成为标配。

🔗 Related Reading: Related Reading: New Li Auto i6 Six Upgrades 🔗 相关阅读： 相关阅读：新款理想 i6 六项升级

item.title: 山姆拟限制亲友卡换绑，一年最多关联两名主卡会员
item.guid: 山姆拟限制亲友卡换绑，一年最多关联两名主卡会员
item.description:
Sam's Club announced on October 9 that it plans to amend its membership charter and solicit public comments, adding restrictions on the binding of real-name identities for family and friend cards. 山姆会员商店 10 月 9 日宣布，拟修改会员章程并公开征求意见，新增亲友卡实名身份的绑定限制。

According to the proposed rules, for every 365 days from the date of first activation of a family and friend card, the same real-name identity information can only be used to activate family and friend cards for a maximum of two individual primary card members; at any given moment, only one family and friend card for one individual primary card member can be active. 按拟议规则，从首次激活亲友卡之日起每 365 天，同一实名身份信息最多只能用于激活两名个人主卡会员的亲友卡；同一时刻，只能激活一名个人主卡会员的亲友卡。

These two restrictions respectively target the number of primary cards that can be linked within a year and the relationships that can be active simultaneously. If no changes are made after the public comment period, the new rules will take effect on October 16; they are currently still in the public comment phase. 这两项限制分别针对一年内可关联的主卡人数和同时生效的关系。征求意见期满如无更改，新规则将于 10 月 16 日生效，目前仍处于征求意见阶段。

item.title: Saint Laurent 创意总监 Anthony Vaccarello 将离任，结束十年任期
item.guid: Saint-Laurent-创意总监-Anthony-Vaccarello-将离任，结束十年任期
item.description:
Kering Group announced on October 9 that Anthony Vaccarello will depart from his role as Creative Director of Saint Laurent, ending a ten-year tenure, with his successor to be announced later. 开云集团 10 月 9 日宣布，Anthony Vaccarello 将离开 Saint Laurent 创意总监一职，结束长达十年的任期，继任者将稍后公布。

Vaccarello succeeded Hedi Slimane in 2016. During his tenure, he held major shows with the Eiffel Tower as a backdrop, continuing the brand's Parisian identity, and also propelled Saint Laurent into film production, participating in works such as 'Emilia Pérez'. Vaccarello 于 2016 年接替 Hedi Slimane。他任内以埃菲尔铁塔为背景举办大秀，延续品牌的巴黎身份，也推动 Saint Laurent 进入电影制作，参与了《艾米莉亚·佩雷斯》等作品。

In last week's final show, he echoed Yves Saint Laurent's original show scenes with golden gowns, trench coats, and high heels. This personnel change comes as Kering CEO Luca de Meo drives group adjustments; Saint Laurent also became the last major brand in the group to change its creative director in this round. 在上周的最后一场秀中，他以金色礼服、风衣和高跟鞋呼应 Yves Saint Laurent 当年办秀的场景。此次人事变化发生在开云 CEO Luca de Meo 推动集团调整之际；Saint Laurent 也成为集团旗下此轮最后更换创意总监的主要品牌。

item.title: 《旺达幻视》主创将为亚马逊开发《星际之门》新剧
item.guid: 《旺达幻视》主创将为亚马逊开发《星际之门》新剧
item.description:
According to an exclusive report by Variety on October 9, 'WandaVision' creator Jac Schaeffer is developing a new 'Stargate' series for Amazon MGM Studios. Sources say the project is expected to assemble a writers' room soon; representatives for Amazon and Schaeffer declined to comment. 据 Variety 10 月 9 日独家报道，《旺达幻视》主创 Jac Schaeffer 正在为 Amazon MGM Studios 开发一部新的《星际之门》剧集。消息人士称，项目预计不久后组建编剧室；亚马逊和 Schaeffer 的代表均拒绝置评。

The new series is part of an overall deal Schaeffer signed with Amazon MGM this year. Joby Harold and Tory Tunnell of Safehouse Pictures will also serve as executive producers. This marks Amazon's renewed attempt to develop a 'Stargate' TV series, after a previous version advanced by Martin Gero ultimately did not proceed. 新剧属于 Schaeffer 今年与 Amazon MGM 签订的整体合作协议。Safehouse Pictures 的 Joby Harold 与 Tory Tunnell 也将担任执行制片人。这是亚马逊再次尝试开发《星际之门》电视剧，此前由 Martin Gero 推进的版本最终未能继续。

Schaeffer previously wrote 'WandaVision' for Marvel and Disney+, and subsequently served as writer, showrunner, and executive producer for the spin-off series 'Agatha', also directing some episodes. 'Stargate' began with the 1994 film starring James Spader and Kurt Russell, later spawning the ten-season series 'Stargate SG-1', as well as 'Stargate: Atlantis' and other series. Schaeffer 曾为 Marvel 与 Disney+ 创作《旺达幻视》，随后负责衍生剧《阿加莎》的编剧、统筹与执行制片，并执导其中部分集数。《星际之门》则从 1994 年由 James Spader、Kurt Russell 主演的电影起步，后来衍生出播出十季的《星际之门 SG-1》，以及《星际之门：亚特兰蒂斯》等剧集。

item.title: AI 剧集《Space Nation》《Kira》将在 Mipcom 放映完整试播集
item.guid: AI-剧集《Space-Nation》《Kira》将在-Mipcom-放映完整试播集
item.description:
Two sci-fi series produced using generative AI, 'Space Nation' and 'Kira', announced that their full pilot episodes will be screened for buyers at the Mipcom TV market in Cannes on October 12 and 13. Both works are produced by Ex Machina Studios, with K5 International handling global sales. 两部使用生成式 AI 制作的科幻剧集《Space Nation》和《Kira》宣布，将于 10 月 12 日、13 日在戛纳 Mipcom 电视市场面向买家放映完整试播集。两部作品均由 Ex Machina Studios 制作，K5 International 负责全球销售。

'Space Nation' is co-produced by Utopai Studios and Brazilian streamer Globoplay, planned for 8 episodes, 45 minutes each, telling the story of a group of young elite pilots who enter battle when Earth faces an alien threat. Marco Weber and Martin Weisz co-created the series, with Weisz directing all episodes. 《Space Nation》由 Utopai Studios 与巴西流媒体 Globoplay 联合制作，计划共 8 集、每集 45 分钟，讲述地球面对外星威胁时，一群年轻精英飞行员投入战斗的故事。Marco Weber 与 Martin Weisz 联合创作，Weisz 执导全部剧集。

The French-produced 'Kira' is planned for 6 episodes, 35 minutes each, created and directed by Damien Steck and Julien Petit. The teenage girl Kira travels across the changing landscapes and different factions on the living planet Djena, searching for her missing father. K5 states that what is being brought to the market this time are completed episodes, distinct from concept shorts or preview clips. 法国制作的《Kira》计划共 6 集、每集 35 分钟，由 Damien Steck 与 Julien Petit 创作、执导。少女 Kira 在活着的星球 Djena 上穿越变化的地貌与不同派系，寻找失踪父亲。K5 称，本次带到市场的是已完成的剧集，区别于概念短片或预览片。

Utopai previously announced plans to release 3 films and 2 series in 2027; this pilot screening marks new progress in the production and distribution of related works. Utopai 此前公布 2027 年推出 3 部电影、2 部剧集的计划；本次试播集放映是相关作品制作与发行的新进展。

item.title: 冰岛犯罪剧《Elma》定档 10 月 15 日上线
item.guid: 冰岛犯罪剧《Elma》定档-10-月-15-日上线
item.description:
The Icelandic crime drama 'Elma' announced its premiere on the local platform Síminn on October 15. The series is adapted from Eva Björg Ægisdóttir's bestselling novel series, with Unnur Birna Backman starring as detective Elma. 冰岛犯罪剧《Elma》宣布将于 10 月 15 日在当地平台 Síminn 上线。剧集改编自 Eva Björg Ægisdóttir 的畅销小说系列，由 Unnur Birna Backman 饰演警探 Elma。

After a failed relationship, Elma returns to her hometown of Akranes and joins the local police force. A female body appears at the foot of a lighthouse, and the investigation gradually uncovers the town's past secrets; her colleague Saevar becomes an important partner as she deals with cases and her personal life. Elma 在一段感情受挫后返回家乡阿克拉内斯，加入当地警队。灯塔脚下出现一具女性尸体，调查逐步揭开小镇过去的秘密；同事 Saevar 则成为她面对案件与个人生活时的重要伙伴。

The series is directed by Katrín Björgvinsdóttir and Þóra Hilmarsdóttir, directors of works such as 'Trapped', co-produced by Glassriver and Belgian Lunamine, with Mediawan handling global sales, and Finnish MTV having pre-bought it. 剧集由《绝境》等作品的导演 Katrín Björgvinsdóttir 与 Þóra Hilmarsdóttir 执导，Glassriver 与比利时 Lunamine 联合制作，Mediawan 负责全球销售，芬兰 MTV 已预购。
